model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different language model configurations as a function of the number of completions (k), which is displayed on the x-axis on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ (i.e., 1 to 256). The x-axis tick labels are spaced at powers of two, and the axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)". The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", is on a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Four lines are shown, each representing a different model configuration: Llama-3B (blue solid line with circular markers), Llama-3B + FT (dark green solid line with triangular markers), Llama-1B (light blue dashed line with circular markers), and Llama-1B + FT (light green dashed line with triangular markers). All four lines show an increasing trend in coverage as k increases. At k = 2⁰ (1 completion), the coverage values are approximately 0.43 for Llama-3B, 0.42 for Llama-3B + FT, 0.25 for Llama-1B, and 0.24 for Llama-1B + FT. At k = 2⁸ (256 completions), the coverage values reach approximately 0.89 for Llama-3B, 0.90 for Llama-3B + FT, 0.84 for Llama-1B, and 0.85 for Llama-1B + FT. The Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT lines are nearly overlapping and consistently higher than the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT lines across the range of k. The Llama-3B + FT line slightly surpasses the Llama-3B line at higher values of k, while the Llama-1B + FT line is slightly above the Llama-1B line throughout.
